AMD FidelityFX SDK v1.1.4 (https://github.com/GPUOpen-LibrariesAndSDKs/FidelityFX-SDK, tag v1.1.4), MIT (LICENSE.txt), unmodified: the shadow denoiser (gpu/denoiser/ffx_denoiser_shadows_*), the GPU core headers it includes (gpu/ffx_*.h) and the Vulkan pass shaders (passes/, from sdk/src/backends/vk/shaders/denoiser). Used by the 64-bit ray-tracing helper (rthelper/), which compiles them with glslang at run time.
